prompt: A developer wants to contribute code on GitHub.com. What is GitHub’s policy on 2FA for them?
explanation: GitHub requires two-factor authentication for code contributors on GitHub.com — securing the software supply chain one account at a time, and making "how do I enable 2FA" a genuinely practical exam answer.

options.text: 2FA is required to contribute code on GitHub.com
2FA is required only for organization owners
2FA is optional for everyone and always will be
2FA is required only when signing in from a new country
